About the Firm

A Firm Built on Integrity

N. Goje & Co is an Abuja-based full-service law firm advising Nigerian companies, SMEs, startups, and private clients before the CAC, SEC, FIRS, and all superior courts of record.

We are known for clear advice, commercial pragmatism, and unwavering ethics. Whether navigating complex regulatory environments or resolving high-stakes disputes, our attorneys bring focused expertise and genuine commitment to every matter we handle.

Book a Consultation
  • Registered before the Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC)
  • Admitted to practice in all superior courts in Nigeria
  • Arbitration — authenticated documents for international use
  • Deep expertise in Nigerian energy, real estate, and corporate sectors
  • Confidential, client-centered counsel since 2015
  • Fluent in commercial and regulatory practice across FCT and beyond
What We Do

Our Practice Areas

Comprehensive legal services across the full spectrum of corporate, commercial, and personal legal matters.

🏛️

Corporate & Commercial Law

Company incorporation, M&A advisory, contract drafting, and transactional support for businesses of all sizes across Nigeria.

⚖️

Litigation & Dispute Resolution

Vigorous representation in civil and commercial disputes before all superior courts of record, arbitration panels, and mediation forums.

🏠

Real Estate & Property Law

Title verification, conveyancing, land registration, leasing, and property development transactions across the FCT and Nigeria.

⛽

Energy, Oil & Gas

Licensing, regulatory compliance, joint venture structuring, and commercial agreements for energy sector operators and investors.

👨‍👩‍👧

Family Law & Probate

Matrimonial matters, custody arrangements, wills and estate planning, probate proceedings, and succession advisory.

📋

Regulatory Compliance & Company Secretariat

Ongoing compliance management, statutory filings with CAC and SEC, company secretarial services, and corporate governance advisory.
